fact: On 1 November 2024 ANICNS gave the Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Renaissance in Kinshasa 20 computers, 20 tablets and 5 routers, financed entirely by the Congolese government, to create 40 digitised workstations and put into service an ANICNS-approved hospital information system intended to ease portability of the computerised patient record.
title: Kinshasa : le Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Renaissance bénéficie d’un lot d’équipements numériques
